wording: [Skill – I Walked Under Heaven’s Sky obtained!]
holderQuote: By contrast, Pawn was similarly incapacitated. However, he would live as indicated. And while he hadn’t gotten a miracle to cure poison…sadly…he had leveled the most of any one person on that battlefield.
So Pawn bowed his head in prayer
I could use my Skill. [I Walked Under Heaven’s Sky]?
It looks like Pawn’s capstone Skill, [I Walked Under Heaven’s Sky].
Pawn raised his censer high and swung it as the swarms of locust buzzed past him.
effectQuote: The locusts died. As they entered the colors, they fell.

holderQuote: The Painted Antinium charged over the broken ground as spells landed around them, and Pawn saw it.
effectQuote: The Antinium were still being shielded by the blessing. It was the only reason they weren’t dead.

holderQuote: Pawn’s Skill had finally run out of power.
The light of Heaven bloomed and reflected around the glass running around Pawn’s capstone Skill.
effectQuote: The light of Heaven bloomed and reflected around the glass

holderQuote: Now, at last, Pawn raised his censer overhead.
